name: footing-alone-writes-sql
says: Only the footing's code writes SQL or imports Drizzle; every other component reaches the database through the footing's interface

held.pending: a check that scans every component's source outside the footing for SQL string literals and for imports of drizzle-orm, naming each; the control's ?tables scaffold is the known exception until the footing replaces it

name: footing-schema-generated
says: The footing's Drizzle schema and migration SQL are generated from the model and never written by hand

held.pending: a check that regenerates the schema and migrations from the model and fails on any difference, and refuses a migration file the generator did not write; the control's hand-written migrations are the known exception until the footing replaces them
